title: Runners execute jobs
summary: A runner is the machine environment that executes a job. runs-on chooses a matching runner label.
introduction: A runner is the machine environment that executes a job. runs-on chooses a matching runner label. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A runner is the machine environment that executes a job. runs-on chooses a matching runner label.
The job asks for GitHub's current Ubuntu runner image. That image changes over time.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain why a project may need to choose an explicit supported image.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: latest is a moving label, not a permanent operating-system version.
